Amperos Health (https://www.amperoshealth.com/) | NYC | Full-time | Engineers & PMs

Amperos Health is building AI agents to automate healthcare revenue cycle workflows so clinics get paid faster and staff can focus on patients. We’re a fast-growing startup with real customers and production AI systems in the wild.

We’re hiring across: - Software Engineers (Full-stack, Infra, Integrations)

- AI / Research Engineers

- Product Managers (Agents, Integrations)

- Design Engineer & AI Deployment roles

We’re looking for people who enjoy high ownership, shipping quickly, and applying AI to real-world problems.

Our full postings are available here: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/amperos

Email me at adam@amperoshealth.com if you're interested!
